aptlock.busy.anon: apt is busy{lim} — the system is installing updates. Try again later.
aptlock.busy.who: apt is busy{lim}: the lock is held by {who} — the system is installing updates. Try again when it’s done.
aptlock.busy_line: Kaskad is already installing packages (another window or the bot) — waiting…
aptlock.install_busy: Kaskad has been installing packages in another window or from the bot for more than {minutes} minutes — try again later.
aptlock.log.gave_up: APT: gave up waiting — the lock is held by {who}
aptlock.log.waited: APT: waited {sec} s while the system installed updates ({who})
aptlock.wait_line: The system is installing updates (apt is busy) — waiting up to 10 minutes…
